candidate.rationale: Choose the untried width-only candidate after inspecting the complete captured route and evaluation histories. Candidate 1 enabled both actions at these physical settings: cell area 160081 um2 versus baseline 161954 um2, setup slack -0.0262439 ns versus +0.19292 ns, hold slack +0.0945523 ns, and zero reported electrical violations. It failed physical_execution and timing, was not rank eligible, and produced no workload energies; its area decrease is not a qualified Q improvement. Its physical cost was 3834.5636487400043 s; retain that failure and cost. Disable operand isolation to remove its potential input-gating delay and capacitance, while retaining the proved exact signed 18-bit reduction to target arithmetic area and switching. The captured report does not identify the critical path or establish which action caused failure; timing recovery and energy benefit remain hypotheses, and disabling isolation gives up its possible switching savings. Keep utilization 40, density 0.55, abc_area 0 and repair_margin 0 to compare this action change directly with measured implementations; there is no electrical evidence motivating extra repair margin. Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6). Baseline remains the qualified incumbent at Q=1.0; this proposal has no measured Q. Protected evaluation must report functional checks, physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, per-workload energy_j and estimated_power_w, activity/parasitic annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, physical/postprocess costs and common budget accounting. Rank only fully qualified measurements, preserve the best qualified result and all failed trials, and respect the shared 1200 s agent budget and three-candidate limit; one candidate evaluation is captured so far and EDA wait is separate. Energy scope is Liberty-model estimation from zero-delay post-route gate activity and extracted SPEF; no glitch or silicon-power claim.
